turns.user: My temperature gauge is climbing and it's still going up.

Then connect the red clamp to the positive terminal of the dead battery, the other red clamp to the positive terminal of the good battery, the black clamp to a grounded metal spot on the engine block of the dead truck, and the other black clamp to the negative terminal of the good battery.
